newsitem.title: USA: Frisch's to buy back 1.1 mln shrs at $15/shr.
newsitem.headline: Frisch's to buy back 1.1 mln shrs at $15/shr.

text.p: Frisch's Restaurants Inc said Monday that based on a preliminary count, it expects to buy about 1,142,966 shares of its common stock at $15.00 per share, in accordance with the terms of its "Dutch Auction" self-tender offer at $15.00 per share.
The company said shares tendered at prices greater than $15.00 will not be purchased. It said the 1,212,479 shares tendered at $15.00 each will be bought pro rata.
The offer will reduce the number of outstanding shares to about six million, from 7,148,334, said the company.
Frisch's operates and licenses family restaurants, some with drive-thru service, under the name Frisch's Big Boy, and owns two Quality Hotels in metropolitan Cincinnati.
